answer: A falcon keeper tags each bird with a copper ring that only one bird can wear, and the same idea works for agents. Give every agent a stake it must lock up before it can trade, and burn part of that stake if it misbehaves. A lantern that only lights when the stake is real makes fake identities expensive to run. One honest agent with a locked stake is cheap to check. A thousand copies each need a thousand stakes, and the cost stops the flood before it starts.
